text.en:
The barrios of Bagumbayan, Bannawag, Bayawa, Estrella, Kalanawe I, Kalanawe II, Katiko,
Malingon, Mangelen, Mangilala, Pidtubo, Sambolawan, Sinaculay, Suben, Tinangan, Tual, Towato, in the
Municipality of Buluan, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby separated from said municipality, and
constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of President Quirino,
in the province of Sultan Kudarat. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site
of the barrio of Sambulawan.

The barrios of Caridad, Didtaras, Gansing, Kabukalan, Kapingkong, Katitisan, Lagao, Lilit,
Madanding, Maligaya, Mamali, Matiompong, Midtapok, New Cebu, Pidtiguian, Pinguiaman, Pimbalayan,
Poblacion, Ponol, Sadsalan, Senaban, Sigayan, Tinomiguez, Torre, Tambak, Tumiao, Udtong and Palumbi in
the Municipality of Sultan sa Barongis, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby separated from said
municipality, and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of
Mariano Marcos, in the province of Sultan Kudarat. The seat of government in the new municipality shall be
in the present site of the barrio of Poblacion.

The barrios of Ala, Banaba, Daladap, Ducay, Esperanza, Guimalia, Ilian, Kamasi, Kangkong,
Kauran, Kayakaya, Maranding, Mao, Margues, Matagobong, New Panay, Numo, Pamadtingan, Sugasa,
Salabaca, Saniag, Sugadol, Talisawa, Tomicor, Tubak, Tukanalogong and Villamor, in the Municipality of
Ampatuan, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby separated from said municipality, and constituted into a
distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of Esperanza, in the province of Sultan
Kudarat. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of the barrio of

The President shall appoint the respective mayors, vice-mayors and councilors of the
aforementioned municipalities who shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the next
general elections for local officials and shall have qualified.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
